free_tier.stated: CNY 88 per month is the vendor's stated floor for the general-purpose cloud line: 1 to 16 vCPU, 1 to 64 GB RAM, a 50 GB system disk, in Hong Kong. The compute line starts at CNY 328 per month on AMD EPYC 7R13 with 2 to 64 vCPU and 4 to 128 GB, and the memory line runs 1 to 32 vCPU with 8 to 256 GB. The page states the data centres are Hong Kong HGC and WTT with CTGNet and CN2 GIA return paths and a 10 ms claim to the mainland, KVM with OVS, three-replica storage, snapshots and a free VPC.
